title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional failover ordering
author: Ava Patel
description: This hotfix addresses a regression introduced in the SLO enforcer where backoff/hysteresis decisions could be applied out-of-order during concurrent regional failover handoffs. The root cause was a race between the per-region circuit-breaker state transition and the global failover coordinator: if a region triggered an aggressive backoff while the coordinator was in the middle of failing over prefixes to another region, some requests were double-shed (counted in both source and target region) and the enforcer's internal counters drifted, causing sustained over-shedding and elevated 5xx rates for a subset of customers. This PR fixes ordering by: 1) making the failover coordinator perform a lightweight pre-check to quiesce regional enforcers (RPC-style soft lock) before committing route moves, 2) introducing idempotent state transitions for the SLO enforcer so duplicate events are no-ops, and 3) adding a bounded smoothing window for backoff counters to avoid abrupt hysteresis amplification. Also includes telemetry and a small integration test harness that simulates concurrent failover + backoff to prevent regressions. Checklist: - [x] reproduce locally with perf-canary harness - [x] unit tests for idempotent transitions - [x] e2e integration test for concurrent failover - [x] add metrics for double-shed detection - [x] changelog/release note entry

notes_for_release_manager: This should be deployed with a short maintenance window for Dedicated clusters where failover topology changes are expected. The quiesce pre-check is best-effort and times out quickly; if you see quiesce failures in the first 10 minutes, rollback plan is to disable the 'coordinator_quiesce' feature flag and redeploy enforcer-only patch (patch prepared in branch hotfix/disable-quiesce).
regression_test_instructions: Run tests/integration/concurrent_failover_test.go with the perf-canary harness using 'make canary-test TARGET=concurrent-failover' and validate metrics: 'slo.double_shed.count' must be zero for the simulated window and 'slo.coordinator_quiesce_latency' < 500ms.
